record.original_question: For the virtual braid group V B_n, determine whether it is linear for all n greater than 3, whether the representation rho: V B_n -> Aut(F_{n+1}) described in the paper is faithful for all n greater than 2, and whether there exist non-equivalent virtual links whose braid closures become equivalent after applying the welded-braid representation rho_A.

evidence.quote: Is it true that V Bn is linear for all n > 3?
Is the representation rho faithful for all n > 2?
Are there some non-equivalent virtual links Lv and L'v that are the closures of the virtual braids ... such that the welded links ... are equivalent as welded links?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $VB_n$ denote the virtual braid group on $n$ strands, defined as the group with generators $\sigma_1,\dots,\sigma_{n-1}$ (classical braid generators) and $\tau_1,\dots,\tau_{n-1}$ (virtual generators) subject to:
- (Braid relations) $\sigma_i\sigma_{i+1}\sigma_i = \sigma_{i+1}\sigma_i\sigma_{i+1}$ for $1\le i\le n-2$, and $\sigma_i\sigma_j = \sigma_j\sigma_i$ for $|i-j|\ge 2$;
- (Symmetric group relations) $\tau_i^2 = 1$, $\tau_i\tau_{i+1}\tau_i = \tau_{i+1}\tau_i\tau_{i+1}$, and $\tau_i\tau_j = \tau_j\tau_i$ for $|i-j|\ge 2$;
- (Mixed relations) $\sigma_i\tau_j = \tau_j\sigma_i$ for $|i-j|\ge 2$, and $\tau_i\tau_{i+1}\sigma_i = \sigma_{i+1}\tau_i\tau_{i+1}$.

Let $F_{n+1}=\langle x_1,\dots,x_n,y\rangle$ be the free group of rank $n+1$. Define a homomorphism $\rho: VB_n\to \mathrm{Aut}(F_{n+1})$ by
$$\rho(\sigma_i):\ x_i\mapsto x_ix_{i+1}x_i^{-1},\ x_{i+1}\mapsto x_i,\ x_k\mapsto x_k\ (k\ne i,i+1),\ y\mapsto y,$$
$$\rho(\tau_i):\ x_i\mapsto y\,x_{i+1}\,y^{-1},\ x_{i+1}\mapsto y^{-1}x_i y,\ x_k\mapsto x_k\ (k\ne i,i+1),\ y\mapsto y.$$

Let $\rho_A: WB_n\to \mathrm{Aut}(F_n)$ denote the standard faithful Artin-type representation of the welded braid group $WB_n$ (the quotient of $VB_n$ by the "forbidden" relation $\tau_i\sigma_{i+1}\sigma_i=\sigma_{i+1}\sigma_i\tau_{i+1}$), sending $\sigma_i$ to the usual Artin automorphism and $\tau_i$ to the transposition $x_i\leftrightarrow x_{i+1}$ of $F_n=\langle x_1,\dots,x_n\rangle$. For a virtual braid $\beta\in VB_n$, let $\hat\beta$ denote its braid closure as a virtual link, and let $\hat\beta_w$ denote its closure regarded as a welded link.

Resolve the following three questions:
(a) Is $VB_n$ a linear group (i.e., admits a faithful finite-dimensional linear representation over a field) for every $n>3$?
(b) Is the representation $\rho:VB_n\to \mathrm{Aut}(F_{n+1})$ defined above faithful for every $n>2$?
(c) Do there exist virtual braids $\beta,\beta'\in VB_n$ (for some $n$) whose closures $\hat\beta$ and $\hat\beta'$ are inequivalent as virtual links, while $\hat\beta_w$ and $\hat\beta'_w$ are equivalent as welded links?
artifact.status_search_result: Recent literature (2021–2025) continues to investigate linearity of $VB_n$ and faithfulness of representations into $\mathrm{Aut}$ of free groups. While $VB_3$ is known to be linear and faithful linear representations of certain crystallographic quotients have been built, linearity of $VB_n$ for $n>3$ is still treated as an open problem. The Bardakov-style representation $\rho$ into $\mathrm{Aut}(F_{n+1})$ is known to be non-faithful in some forms for $n\ge 4$, but the specific faithfulness question and the welded-vs-virtual closure distinction remain unresolved in general.

status_evidence.title: Virtual and universal braid groups, their quotients and representations
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs new representations of VB_n into Aut of free products; notes that previously known representations are not faithful for n >= 4.
status_evidence.claim: Faithfulness of representations of VB_n into Aut of free groups remains an active question.

status_evidence.title: On Universal Virtual and Welded Braid Groups and Their Linear Representations
status_evidence.snippet: Studies linear representations of virtual and welded braid groups; linearity for VB_n with n>3 still discussed as open.
status_evidence.claim: Linearity of VB_n for n>3 is not established.

status_evidence.title: Local Representations of the Flat Virtual Braid Group
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) work continues to explore representations of virtual braid groups, indicating the linearity/faithfulness questions remain active.
status_evidence.claim: The questions are still under active investigation.
